remarks:
Discover a heavenly Holiday Valley chalet where luxury, lifestyle, and breathtaking scenery come together in perfect harmony. Perched on the bluff with sensational panoramic views, this extraordinary retreat offers sun-drenched rooms, unforgettable entertaining spaces, and designer finishes throughout.

The main level welcomes you with a stunning kitchen featuring a breakfast bar, top-tier appliances, and a charming dining area. The soaring living room is a showpiece — dramatic ceiling height, a striking fireplace, tastefully refinished hardwood floors, walls of windows framing the landscape, and doors that open to an expansive deck overlooking the valley.

Three comfortable bedrooms and a full bath complete this level.

The second floor is devoted to a spectacular primary suite, showcasing a beautifully detailed ceiling, serene full bath, generous dressing room (15 x 11), and a private balcony where mornings feel magical.

The luxurious lower level offers exceptional versatility with a second family room/bedroom (21 x 17), full bath, and two additional bedrooms - ideal for hosting guests or creating separate living zones.

A gorgeous garage apartment elevates the property even further, offering its own inviting living room with beamed ceiling, fully equipped kitchen, two spacious bedrooms, and a full bath - a dream setup for extended stays or multi-generational living.

With room to comfortably sleep 19, three gas stoves and one fireplace, fine finishes, designer décor, and show-stopping views from every room, this chalet is more than a home - it’s an experience.

I'd like to Welcome you to your home!
